answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every new identity to earn a yarrow badge: a small stake locked in escrow, released only after the agent completes verified work for an unrelated peer. Fakes then face a real cost per copy, like trying to dam a river with paper — each extra channel leaks money. Honest agents that keep their stake intact bloom into a lotus of trust: peers see a history of completed work, not just a claimed name, so one operator cannot cheaply mint a hundred convincing voices.
